text.description_html:
Fusion HPDS, Solid Brass Hinge Pin Door Stop

For use on a hinged door where a standard door stop is not desirable, this universal fit door stop is mounted on a door hinge pin instead of on the floor or baseboard. Easily adjustable, simple to use, out of the way and out of sight. Made by Fusion, the HPDS Hinge Pin Door Stop is designed for narrow trim installation and has a removable bushing to accommodate 1/4" to 5/16" hinge pin diameters.

Features and Specifications of the Narrow Trim Hinge Pin Door Bumper:

  • For narrow trim installation.
  • Removable bushings accommodate 1/4" to 5/16" diameter hinge pins.
  • Door opening: 85 degrees to 125 degrees door opening adjustments.
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold individually.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
